Import a criteria pipeline from YAML

Source: R/yaml.R
import_criteria.Rd

Reads a YAML file (or string) written by export_criteria() and reconstructs a cf_criteria object.

Usage

import_criteria(path = NULL, text = NULL, envir = parent.frame())

Arguments

path

A file path to read from. Exactly one of path or text must be supplied.

text

A YAML string. Exactly one of path or text must be supplied.

envir

The environment in which to evaluate re-parsed expressions.

Value

A cf_criteria object.

Security

Criteria files contain R code: every formula and function predicate is parsed and evaluated when the file is imported (and again when the criteria are applied), and fn_ref entries are looked up and called. Treat a criteria file like an R script: do not import files from untrusted sources.

See also

export_criteria() to write a pipeline.

Other yaml: export_criteria()

Examples

yml <- "
cohortflow_criteria:
  version: 1
  steps:
    - label: Adults only
      type: include
      kind: formula
      expr: age >= 18
    - label: Withdrew consent
      type: exclude
      kind: formula
      expr: withdrew
"
crit <- import_criteria(text = yml)
crit
#> Cohort criteria pipeline  (2 steps)
#>    1. [+][~] (include) Adults only
#>           age >= 18
#>    2. [-][~] (exclude) Withdrew consent
#>           withdrew

dat <- mock_parallel_rct(n_participants = 100, seed = 1)
apply_criteria(dat, crit)
#> No `id` supplied and no `.cf_row_id` column found. Adding a sequential `.cf_row_id`.
#> Cohort flow  (2 steps | 100 -> 90 rows | 10 excluded)
#> ------------------------------------------------------------
#>    1. [+] Adults only
#>        n_in: 100  kept: 94  removed: 6
#>    2. [-] Withdrew consent
#>        n_in: 94  kept: 90  removed: 4
